title: Premier League: who should your club sign before the transfer window closes?
trail: With one week to go before the end of the summer transfer window, we’d like to hear which players you want to recruit
body: With the transfer window open for another week, we’d like to hear who you would like to see driving through your club’s gates before the deadline on 31 August. Perhaps you’ve already seen enough of your defenders to know leadership at the back is top priority? Are the strikers you were excited about in pre-season already missing sitters? Whether it’s a new No9 or substitute left-back, we’d like to know which players would improve your club. We’ll feature a summary of your transfer requests before deadline day.
